additionalHardening: Full UUID unit name and Description bind the exact phase/digest; exact absent-unit plus absent-cgroup preflight precedes launch.
Only matching Id, Description, transient=yes and exact transient fragment authorize stop. Collected units are observed but not stopped; foreign or malformed state blocks cleanup and acceptance.
Explicit system.slice/control-group/SIGKILL; final exact stopped states, zero PIDs and absent or populated=0 cgroup evidence are mandatory. Missing event data and stop failures remain failures.
Launch-attempt state survives later log finalization exceptions; stdout/stderr are retained on launch error or local subprocess timeout. Exit 3 remains 3.
Plan distinguishes already-satisfied freeze prerequisites, static review, new simulated executor checks and deferred real Linux acceptance.
